item.title: Sweep AI Review 2026: GitHub Issue to PR Automation — Is It Worth It?
item.description: Sweep AI is a GitHub App that converts issues into pull requests autonomously — you add a sweep label to an issue, and Sweep analyzes the codebase, writes a plan, generates code changes, and opens a PR. With 7,600+ GitHub stars (Apache-2.0), a 92% issue resolution rate in controlled evaluations, and a free tier that starts at $0 versus Devin’s $500/month, it occupies a specific and defensible niche. Here’s whether it’s the right tool for your team in 2026.
